pr.body:
## The problem:
When a Jira issue's `assignee` field is quickly modified multiple times in a row, we end up assigning and resyncing the assignees to Jira, which causes a loop. This is because _all_ inbound integration webhooks that modify an issue assignment generate an outbound update for all issue sync integrations as well.

## Solution:
This PR adds a new `AssignmentSource` dataclass, which acts as a context carrier when an external webhook triggers an issue assignment change. This is then checked on the outbound sync logic, preventing the change from being propagated to the same integration that initially triggered the change.
pr.title: fix(ecosystem): Breaks issue sync cycles

raw_findings.body: from_dict returns a non-None AssignmentSource, but the string ID does not equal the integer organization-integration ID; the outbound update is therefore sent back to the source integration and can recreate the synchronization loop this patch is intended to stop.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Structurally valid but incorrectly typed queue data is treated as trusted source metadata and fails the source-ID comparison silently.
raw_findings.impact: from_dict returns a non-None AssignmentSource, but the string ID does not equal the integer organization-integration ID; the outbound update is therefore sent back to the source integration and can recreate the synchronization loop this patch is intended to stop.
raw_findings.root_cause: The parser assumes dataclass annotations enforce runtime types, while dataclass construction only validates argument names and presence.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Explicitly validate the deserialized values before construction, requiring a string source_name, an integer integration_id, and a datetime queued value when supplied; return None for invalid types and cover them in tests.
raw_findings.title: Malformed source field types bypass from_dict validation and can defeat cycle suppression
raw_findings.trigger: A stale, manually scheduled, or otherwise malformed task payload contains the required keys but encodes `integration_id` as a string, such as `{"source_name": "Jira", "integration_id": "123"}`.

raw_findings.body: The old `sync_assignee_outbound(external_issue_id, user_id, assign)` task rejects `assignment_source_dict` as an unexpected keyword argument, causing assignment-sync jobs to fail during deployment.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Mixed-version producers and consumers cannot execute the same queued task message.
raw_findings.impact: The old `sync_assignee_outbound(external_issue_id, user_id, assign)` task rejects `assignment_source_dict` as an unexpected keyword argument, causing assignment-sync jobs to fail during deployment.
raw_findings.root_cause: The producer unconditionally changes the serialized argument schema of an existing asynchronous task without a backward-compatible deployment path.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Roll this out in a consumer-first compatibility stage before producers emit the new key, or introduce an explicitly versioned compatible task protocol; avoid emitting the key when it is None as an additional reduction in exposure.
raw_findings.title: The new task kwarg is incompatible with workers from the previous release
raw_findings.trigger: During a rolling deployment, an updated web or worker process enqueues this task while a worker still running the previous task definition consumes it; this happens even for ordinary assignments because the new key is sent with None.

raw_findings.body: The polymorphic call raises `TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'assignment_source'`, despite the abstract interface declaring the keyword valid.
raw_findings.failure_mode: An implementation accepted as an IssueSyncIntegration cannot be called according to its base-class API.
raw_findings.impact: The polymorphic call raises `TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'assignment_source'`, despite the abstract interface declaring the keyword valid.
raw_findings.root_cause: The base method signature was widened without updating all concrete overrides to honor the new callable contract.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Remove this unrelated parameter from the status-sync abstract method if it is not needed, or update every override—including ExampleIntegration—to accept and correctly handle the keyword or `**kwargs`.
raw_findings.title: The expanded abstract status-sync contract is not implemented by every subclass
raw_findings.trigger: Code calls `sync_status_outbound(..., assignment_source=source)` through the newly declared IssueSyncIntegration contract on ExampleIntegration, whose override accepts only the original three arguments.

raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add a second linked integration with outbound assignee sync enabled and assert that the source receives no update while the second integration receives exactly one update.
raw_findings.title: The cycle-prevention test does not verify propagation to another integration

validated_findings.title: Source suppression on inbound unassignment has no regression test
